title: Khiladi Khel Ka
desc: A man poses as a tantric to earn money for his love interest's orphanage. However, things take a turn when a ghost begins to follow him after he pretends to perform an exorcism.

title: Chatrapathi
desc: A man begins a quest to rejoin his legal guardians after losing his kin in a battle. However, he encounters hurdles as a sibling plots his ruin.

title: Mujhe Kucch Kehna Hai
desc: An accident brings Karan and Pooja close to each other. When Karan finally decides to propose to her, he realises that destiny has other plans for them.

title: Shiva The Super Hero 3
desc: A group of three young friends decides to invest in a resort. However, things become complicated when they realise that it is haunted and take the help of a mentalist to track down the ghost.

title: Bhairavakona
desc: After committing a robbery, Basava and his companion, John, run into Agraharam Geetha, a stranger, and the trio end up in Bhairavakona, a village shrouded in mystery.

title: Om Bheem Bush
desc: Three scientists arrive at a village in search of a treasure. However, things take a turn when they explore a haunted palace and discover black magic.
